body_html:
Maybe I shouldn't go all @chisaldrich and keep my notes, bookmarks, and status updates off of wordpress instead.

Looking at my blog feed many articles are not displaying for some reasons. My theme has the "format" chpice for posts and I am using post-kind #indieweb plug in.

A bunch of recent articles not showing in feed.

Maybe I should move status updates to Known. Also just tried micro.blog. May give that a whirl.
